ABOUT.hero.metaDescription: Learn about Soul Paradise Travels - Your trusted IATA-accredited travel partner founded by Mr. Sanjay Srivastava and Mrs. Shafali Srivastava in Jalandhar, Punjab

ABOUT.story.title: More than a destination
paragraphs: Soul Paradise is a proud initiative founded by **Mr. Sanjay Srivastava** and **Mrs. Shafali Srivastava**, driven by a passion for making travel accessible, affordable, and memorable for everyone.

What started as a vision to provide exceptional travel services has grown into a trusted name in the industry. We believe that every journey should be more than just a destination - it should be an experience that enriches your life.
Based in **Jalandhar, Punjab**, we've built our reputation on three pillars: competitive pricing, personalized service, and unwavering commitment to quality.
